snippet.title: 🧋 Bingbao is bringing back all the limited-time recipes for Steam Next Fest!
snippet.description:
Hello, shop owners! Bingbao here!

We're excited to share that Boba Cafe Simulator will be participating in Steam Next Fest this June!

📅 June 12 – June 23

During Next Fest, the Demo will be updated with a brand-new version featuring:

✨ A completely redesigned UI
✨ All limited-time recipes returning
✨ More improvements, polish, and gameplay enhancements

Simply download or update the Demo on Steam to try the latest version!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🧋 About Boba Cafe Simulator

Boba Cafe Simulator is a co-op management simulation game for up to 8 players.

Start from scratch and build your dream bubble tea empire:

🥤 Handcraft over 120 drinks, including milk teas, fruit teas, and coffee

🏪 Design your menu and set your own prices

📦 Manage dine-in, takeout, and delivery orders

🛋️ Decorate and customize your shop layout

🌱 Grow ingredients, hire staff, and expand your business

🤝 Play with up to 8 friends (or cause a little chaos together)

From a small neighborhood shop to a thriving bubble tea empire—the journey is yours!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

We'd love for you to download and try the Demo! (You can play it right now!)

The game is still actively in development, and wishlists mean the world to us ❤️

Every follow and every wishlist helps keep Bingbao shaking more bubble tea.

See you at Steam Next Fest! 🧋✨
